title: Natural absolute Galois action on geometric etale lifts with open stabilizers
statement: Let K, Ks, and Omega be fields in Type u, with compatible K-algebra structures on Ks and Omega and a Ks-algebra structure on Omega. Assume Ks is a separable closure of K [def-pd-separable-closure] and Omega is algebraically closed. Put S = Spec K and let p be the point of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] given by Spec Omega -> S [def-weil-geometric-point]. There exists a monoid homomorphism rho from Gal(Ks/K), with its Krull topology, to the endomorphisms of the Type u valued functor p.fiber. For every g, every K-automorphism tau of Omega extending g through Ks -> Omega, every etale S-scheme X and lift x : Spec Omega -> X over S, the lift rho(g)_X(x) is Spec(tau) followed by x. For every X and x, the set of g with rho(g)_X(x) = x is open. This is a statement about geometric lifts only, with no sheaves, stalk colimits, or lifted stalk functor.

source.place: Tag 03QW, section-galois-action-stalks, action formula and factorization through the absolute Galois group

proof.text: Extend g from Ks to the algebraic closure of K inside Omega; this is possible by the algebraic extension theorem. Choose a transcendence basis of Omega over that algebraic closure, fix its elements, and extend the resulting isomorphism of rational function fields to their algebraic closure Omega. The extension is an automorphism because both source and target are algebraic closures of the rational function field. It fixes K and restricts to g on the specified embedding of Ks.

For a geometric lift x to an etale K-scheme X, factor x through Spec of the residue field of its image point. The residue field is finite separable over K by the etale-fibre lemma, after identifying the residue field of the unique point of Spec K with K. Its image in Omega lies in the image of Ks, because Ks is separably closed and every element of this image is separable algebraic over K. Thus extensions of the same g have identical composites with x. Define rho(g) by precomposition with Spec of any extension. This value is independent of the extension; postcomposition commutes with precomposition, proving naturality. Spec reverses composition, so rho(gh)(x) = rho(g)(rho(h)(x)); the identity gives the identity transformation. These facts give the monoid homomorphism and its asserted formula.

The finite separable residue-field image is a finite intermediate field of Ks/K. Its fixing subgroup is open in the Krull topology and fixes x, using the preceding factorization. The stabilizer of x is a subgroup by the established action laws. Any subgroup containing an open subgroup is open, since it is a union of translates of that subgroup (Mathlib Subgroup.isOpen_mono). Hence the stabilizer set in the statement is open.

For an etale scheme X over a field K, geometric lifts Spec Omega to X form a functor with an action of Gal Ks K and open stabilizers
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results, including Scheme.Etale.forget, Scheme.Etale.forgetFullyFaithful, StandardEtalePair.homEquiv and Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod; no natural absolute Galois action on Omega-valued etale lifts.
Four matches for transport from point morphisms to stalk morphisms; these prove the parent colimit construction but do not provide an absolute Galois action on point fibres.

KrullTopology has IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_isOpen. IsAlgClosed.Basic has surjective_domRestrict_of_isAlgebraic. EtalePoint constructs p.fiber, but no natural Galois point-action theorem. Blueprint search for geometric points and Galois action found no duplicate of this precise lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_galoisPointAction
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω))
    let p := pointSmallEtale s
    ∃ ρ : Gal(Ks/K) →* End p.fiber,
      (∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (_ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X),
        ((ρ g).app X x).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left) ∧
      (∀ (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X),
        IsOpen {g : Gal(Ks/K) | (ρ g).app X x = x})
